name: Clone Jutsu
desc: The first trick every academy student learns: hollow copies of yourself that look real but fade at the first touch.
tip: Keep it light. Three quick signs, then imagine two outlines of yourself stepping out to each side.

name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
desc: Splits your chakra evenly into solid copies that can fight, scout and learn, then hand their memories back to you.
tip: Canon uses a cross-shaped clone seal the detector can't see; Mizunoe stands in for it. Hold it firmly before the final Tiger.

name: Clone Great Explosion
desc: A shadow clone grabs hold of the enemy and then detonates its own chakra in a violent blast.
tip: Make the clone, then snap into Bird as the trigger.

name: Substitution Jutsu
desc: At the instant of impact you swap places with a nearby object, leaving the attacker striking a plain wooden log.
tip: Flow through the five signs smoothly; the log appears in a puff where you stood.

name: Transformation Jutsu
desc: A cloud of smoke and you wear someone else's shape: a classmate, a stranger, even a shuriken.
tip: Finish on a crisp Ram and hold it as the smoke clears.

name: Body Flicker Technique
desc: Chakra-boosted footwork so fast it looks like teleporting, leaving only an afterimage behind.
tip: Canon uses a single Tiger; this app adds Bird and Hare. Move your hands fast, then freeze.

name: Shadow Possession Jutsu
desc: Your shadow stretches across the ground, latches onto the target's and forces them to copy every move you make.
tip: Canon is a single Rat; here it's Rat, Ox, Rat. Drop your hands and break the Rat between, or it won't count twice.

name: Eight Trigrams Sealing Style
desc: A spiral seal written onto the body that locks something immense inside while slowly leaking its chakra to the host.
tip: Picture a spiral of script glowing on your stomach as you press your palms together.

name: Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death
desc: The victim believes a tree has grown around them and locked them in place, while blossoms drift down and the caster closes in.
tip: Calm, deliberate signs. Genjutsu is about control, not force.

name: Scattering Thousand Crows
desc: A storm of black crows bursts outward and fills the victim's vision, hiding the caster's real movements.
tip: Finish on Tiger and flick your hands open as the flock scatters.

name: Tsukuyomi
desc: One look traps the victim in a red-and-black world where the caster controls time; days of torment pass in a blink.
tip: Canon needs only a Mangekyō glance; this app gives it three signs. Keep your eyes locked on the lens.

name: Mystical Palm Technique
desc: Hands glow green as chakra pours into a wound, speeding the body's own repair from the inside.
tip: Canon is a modified Ox then Tiger; the app adds Gassho to finish. Breathe slowly, like you're calming a patient.

name: Rasengan
desc: A spinning sphere of pure chakra held in one palm, grinding into whatever it touches.
tip: Canon needs no signs at all; this short pair is the app's trigger. Then open one palm and imagine wind spinning in it.

name: Wind Style: Rasenshuriken
desc: Wind chakra is folded into a Rasengan until it sprouts shrieking blades and cuts at the level of cells.
tip: Canon has no signs. Raise your palm high at the end; the shuriken forms above it.

name: Eight Gates Released Formation
desc: Forcing open the body's chakra gates one by one unlocks impossible strength, wrapped in a boiling aura of sweat turned to steam.
tip: A taijutsu art with no canon signs. Clench your fists after Ox and tense every muscle.

name: Sage Mode
desc: Sitting perfectly still, you draw nature energy into your body until your senses and strength surge.
tip: Canon has no signs, just stillness. Press your palms, breathe, then press again, and stay still for a moment.

name: Chakra Flow
desc: Running chakra along a weapon or your own body so a plain edge suddenly cuts, crackles or burns.
tip: Imagine chakra running down your arm into an invisible sword.
